name: Injuu Kangoku ~Dirty Prison Ship~
source:
In search of resources, humanity sets off into space, the final frontier.
A crew of 14 aboard the spaceship Settler has just finished it's mission,
and is on the way back to Earth.
However, engine trouble leads the crew to board a passing ship...

From there, an unknown life form starts to take control of the crew's reason,
and turns them into lewd beasts.
Can you and the heroines escape alive?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ081982.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
为寻找资源，人类踏入最后的疆域——宇宙。
“Settler”号飞船上的14名船员刚刚完成任务，正在返回地球。
然而，引擎故障迫使众人登上一艘经过的飞船……

从那以后，未知生命体开始控制船员理智，把他们变成淫乱野兽。
你与女主角们能否活着逃出去？

[译自 [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ081982.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
